question: At the Global Production Awards held on 20 May 2025 during the Cannes Film Festival, which city was honoured with the Best City of Film Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Belfast**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Belfast** was awarded the **Best City of Film Award** at the Global Production Awards held during the Cannes Film Festival on **20 May 2025**.
 
• The award recognizes Belfast's contributions to the global film industry, including its infrastructure, talent pool, and support for filmmakers.
 
• Belfast has a rich cinematic heritage, with internationally acclaimed productions such as **"Game of Thrones"** filmed in the region.
 
• The city is home to state-of-the-art film studios such as **Titanic Studios**, which have hosted major global productions.
 
• Belfast's recognition underlines its growing status as a prominent hub for film production on the global stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Global Production Awards**: These awards celebrate excellence in film production across the globe, recognizing cities, studios, and individuals contributing to the industry.
 
• **Cannes Film Festival**: One of the most prestigious film festivals globally, held annually in Cannes, France, celebrating cinematic achievements.
 
• **Game of Thrones**: The globally popular TV series filmed extensively in Northern Ireland, including Belfast, boosting the region's reputation in the film industry.
 
• **Titanic Studios**: A world-class film studio in Belfast, known for hosting major productions, contributing significantly to the city's cinematic footprint.
 
• **Belfast’s Film Industry**: The city has invested heavily in film production infrastructure, attracting filmmakers and fostering local talent to establish itself as a global production hub.
